Inventory records had not been updated to reflect the births of rabbits at the facility. Records must be maintained and
updated to accurately represent the total number of animals held at the facility, including animals sold, or any offspring
born. The facility must correct this issue.
******Correct by September 22, 2026

Multiple rabbit enclosures were identified with exposed screw/nail heads, and areas of worn and jagged wood. The
animals could potentially become injured when enclosures are not maintained in good repair. In addition, chewed and
jagged wood may contain debris and cannot be effectively sanitized. The facility must ensure that animal enclosures are
maintained in good repair in order to protect the animals.
*******Correct by September 22, 2026

Multiple rabbit enclosures were identified with an excessive buildup of fecal material and debris. Fecal material may
harbor disease causing agents and may negatively affect the health of the animals. Enclosures must be reasonably free
of excreta and other debris by periodic cleaning, in addition to being sanitized at least once every 30 days. The facility
must address this issue.
*******Correct by September 22, 2026
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representative.
